extracted.intended_audience: authors and macro-writers preparing TeX formats (booklets, letters, concert programs)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for designing and implementing TeX format files and macros for letters, concert programs, and whole-book layouts (as used to produce The TeXbook). Covers page-layout parameters, font selection, size-switching, special-purpose macros, verbatim displays, footnotes, marginal notes, multi-column output, chapter formatting, and other practical rules for typesetting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page layout parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Set basic page geometry and related parameters such as \hsize, \vsize, \maxdepth, \parindent, \pagewidth, \pageheight, and \ruleht.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example values used: \hsize=29pc, \vsize=44pc, \maxdepth=2.2pt, \parindent=3pc, \pagewidth=\hsize, \pageheight=\vsize, \ruleht=.5pt. Also set display skips: \abovedisplayskip=6pt plus 3pt minus 1pt, \belowdisplayskip=6pt plus 3pt minus 1pt, \abovedisplayshortskip=0pt plus 3pt, \belowdisplayshortskip=4pt plus 3pt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Raggedbottom and interline penalties for page breaks
rubrics_metrics.description: Use \raggedbottom and a rather large \interlinepenalty so that page breaks will tend to occur between paragraphs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \raggedbottom and \interlinepenalty=1000 (also \interlinepenalty5000 used for \ps to prevent breaks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Letter format: modes and longindentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters may be typeset in 'line mode' or 'paragraph mode'; provide \beginlinemode, \beginparmode and an adjustable \longindentation to indent closing material and date and to drive address/label layout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define \longindentation (example \newdimen\longindentation \longindentation=4truein), create \address that boxes address text with hanging indentation if lines exceed \longindentation, and ensure closing macros prevent page breaks between \body and \ps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letterhead and address handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Create reusable macros for letterhead and label generation, placing address both in the letter and copyable for envelope labels; break long address lines and use hanging indentation for continued lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a saved box (e.g., \newbox\theaddress) and \copy\theaddress for printing; leave provision to modify for various organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Load special fonts at true sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Special-purpose fonts (e.g., logos, small heads) should be loaded at 'true' sizes so magnification doesn't affect intended appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: \font\smallheadfont=cmr8 at 8truept, \font\largeheadfont=cmdunh10 at 14.4truept, \font\logofont=manfnt at 14.4truept.

rubrics_metrics.name: Micro-adjustments: raise brackets in phone numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide small macros (e.g., \up) to tweak the vertical placement of characters (such as brackets) so they look better in specific contexts like telephone numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \def\up#1{\leavevmode \raise.16ex\hbox{#1}}

rubrics_metrics.name: Concert program type-size selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide macros to select type sizes appropriate to one-page programs with options for large, medium, and small type to accommodate many subparts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define \bigtype, \medtype, \smalltype to switch fonts and associated \baselineskip values (examples: \baselineskip=14pt minus 1pt for big, 12pt minus 1pt for med, 9.5pt minus .75pt for small).

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow shrinkability in one-page documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Permit shrinkability in \baselineskip for one-page documents to help squeeze copy to fit, but avoid it in book formats where variable spacing across pages would look bad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'minus' component in \baselineskip (e.g., 14pt minus 1pt) and avoid stretchability where uniformity is desired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domain-specific shorthand macros for musical typesetting
rubrics_metrics.description: Define simple macros for recurring music-specific tokens, such as roman parentheses in italic text, sharp and flat symbols, and thin spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: \def\(#1){{\rm(}#1\/\rm)}}, \def\sharp{\raise.4ex\hbox{\mus\char"5D}}, \let\,=\thinspace. Use \mus mapped to the music (math-italic) font in the current size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Composition/movements/soloists macros for program layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide macros that format composition titles, composer right-aligned, movement listings in a multi-column-like alignment, and soloist listings centered and bold.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: \def\composition#1{...\halign{\bf\quad##\hfil\cr ...}}; \def\composer#1{\rightline{\bf#1}}; \def\movements#1{\halign{\quad\it##\hfil&&\qquad\it##\hfil\cr#1\crcr}}; let the user insert \smallskip/\medskip/\bigskip for vertical spacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide optional organization-specific logos/macros
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow special macros (e.g., \tsaologo) for organization-specific ornamentation or title blocks, but keep them easily modifiable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define the macro as a vbox of rules and text so it can be applied only when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show sample pages to the book designer
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare sample pages that include each element that will appear in the final book (chapter titles, illustrations, footnotes, displays, exercises, etc.) and show them to the publisher's designer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is stressed as an important step; the designer uses samples to make coherent decisions (indentation, margins, running heads, type sizes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design coherence decisions (indentation, running heads, folio placement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Make consistent design choices (e.g., uniform indentation for paragraphs and displays, bold page numbers in margins, italic running headlines with caps and lower case).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: uniform indentation of 3 picas for paragraph openings and displays; page numbers in bold at margin; running headlines in italic caps+lowercase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Font selection and size choices for body and special paragraphs
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose appropriate main text and special-paragraph type sizes (e.g., 10-point main text on a 12-point leading, 9-point for 'dangerous bends') and specify \hsize and \vsize accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example choices: main text 10-point on 12pt base, dangerous bends 9-point on 11pt base, and \hsize=29pc, \vsize=44pc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of flexible glue and author's additions
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduce flexible glue (stretch/shrink) to allow coping with cut-and-paste operations and to aid page makeup; authors may add features beyond designer specs when necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The author notes adding flexible glue was an initiative to help with practical page make-up; treat it judiciously since too much flexibility can alter design uniformity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Load and configure math and typewriter fonts (skewchar and hyphenchar)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set math fonts' \skewchar and make typewriter fonts inhibit hyphenation by setting \hyphenchar=-1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: \skewchar\ninei='177; \hyphenchar\ninett=-1 so control sequence names not hyphenated in paragraphs; load multiple sizes for math fonts to support size-switching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement size-switching macros for multiple math sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide macros (e.g., \tenpoint, \ninepoint, \eightpoint) that switch text/font families and associated math families so mathematics renders properly in three sizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set \textfont, \scriptfont, \scriptscriptfont appropriately for families 0–3 and define \it, \sl, \tt, \bf to map to the correct size fonts and set corresponding \normalbaselineskip, \strutbox, and \ttglue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use \ttglue for mixed typewriter text spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Define a \ttglue skip for spacing between words in typewriter-like text to compensate for fixed-width font behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \ttglue=.5em plus.25em minus.15em and set \spaceskip=\ttglue when entering typewriter verbatim contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marginal notes insertion class
rubrics_metrics.description: Create an insertion class (e.g., \newinsert\margin) for marginal notes used during authoring (indexing notes), with no limit on number and zero space used in layout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \dimen\margin=\maxdimen, \count\margin=0, \skip\margin=0pt so marginal inserts take up no space but can be collected and output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote formatting and parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Redefine \footnote to typeset footnotes indented and in 8-point type with specific insert parameters for spacing and maximum size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \insert\footins\bgroup\eightpoint ... \skip\footins=12pt plus 2pt minus 4pt; \dimen\footins=30pc (maximum footnotes per page); set \interlinepenalty and splitting parameters for footnotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control running headlines and title page suppression
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep running-head text in a control sequence (e.g., \rhead) and provide a \titlepage macro to suppress the headline on the next output page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \def\rhead{} initially, \newif\iftitle and \def\titlepage{\global\titletrue}; output routine checks \iftitle to suppress headline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-page output routine attaching headlines, marginal and footnotes
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement an output routine (e.g., \onepageout) that composes the page by adding headlines, marginal notes, main body, and footnotes (with separating hrule) and then \shipout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure registration marks and corner rules are added on title pages; place marginal boxes via \rlap; when footnotes present insert hrule and unvbox\footins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-column index strategy via \vsplit and balancing
rubrics_metrics.description: Handle double-column material (index) by collecting material then using \vsplit to produce two columns and a balancing routine to make last-page columns the same height.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set \hsize to column width (e.g., 14pc), \vsize to double height, use \vsplit to split 255 box into columns, and a \balancecolumns routine that loops increasing split height while setting \vbadness high to avoid spurious underfull reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter front and end formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide \beginchapter and \endchapter macros that generate chapter title pages (with special spacing/line breaks) and closing quotations on right-hand pages; initialize counters for exercises and subsections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \beginchapter parses title tokens, sets \rhead to chapter heading, ejects a titlepage with \titlefont and \inchhigh digits; \endchapter ensures closing quotations are on a right-hand page and sets \leftskip to allow flush-right epigraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dangerous-bend markers and spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Define constructs (e.g., \danger, \ddanger) that typeset a 'dangerous bend' sign in the left margin and adjust paragraph spacing/penalties to isolate the paragraph (clubpenalty, medbreak, hanging).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use \dbend glyph from \manual font, set \clubpenalty=10000, \noindent\hang\hangafter=-2 and enclose in group with \ninepoint; provide \enddanger for rare cases to omit medium space after the paragraph.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbered subsections and answer-numbered paragraphs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide macros to create numbered subsections and answer-numbered paragraphs automatically, incrementing counters and formatting labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \outer\def\subsection#1. {\medbreak\advance\subsecno by 1 \noindent{\it \the\subsecno.\enspace#1.\enspace}} and \def\ansno#1.#2:{...} with \answer generating \ansno calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit hyphenation exceptions when needed
rubrics_metrics.description: List hyphenation exceptions in the format when certain words must break in a specific manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: \hyphenation{man-u-script man-u-scripts ap-pen-dix}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special macros for typographic tokens and visible characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Define convenient macros for frequently used nonstandard tokens (e.g., \MF, \AmSTeX, \bull, \dn, \up, \|, \], \pt, \<...>, \oct, \hex, \cstok) to ensure consistent typography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: \def\MF{{\manual META}\-\{\manual FONT}}; \def\pt{\,\rm pt}; \def\cstok#1{...} to box control-sequence tokens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indented displays and verbatim mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide \begindisplay/\enddisplay for indented multiline displays (allowing \cr separators and local definitions), \begintt/\endtt for verbatim typewriter displays (unbreakable vbox), and \beginlines/\endlines for quoted format file excerpts with rules and optional spacing commands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement verbatim by temporarily changing catcodes (e.g., make '|' a temporary escape), use \obeylines and \obeyspaces for verbatim behavior, ensure explanatory rules (hrule) surround beginlines/endlines, and allow displays to include local macro definitions immediately after \begindisplay.
